content: Vercel and Netlify do not support persistent WebSockets (serverless function model). Railway supports WebSockets but has no permanent free tier as of 2026 (one-time trial credits only). Fly.io removed its free tier in 2024; 2026 pricing is pay-as-you-go, ~2-5 dollars/mo minimum. Render's free Hobby web service plan (750 free instance-hours/mo) supports WebSockets and is the most viable zero-cost option for a persistent Node/Socket.IO server, with the caveat that it spins down after 15 min of inactivity.
